text: I was charged twice for my donation last week. Please fix this.

got.draft:
Hi Sam,

Thank you for letting us know about the duplicate charge. I'm sorry for the error.

To help our team investigate, please reply with the date and amount of both charges. You can also email these details to donorcare@example.org.

Donor Care will review your request within 2 business days. If a duplicate is confirmed, the extra charge will be refunded in full to your original payment method.

The Lanternwood Team

notes: Should apologize once and give a concrete next step.
